query:
SELECT r.content
           FROM entries e
           CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
               SELECT r.content
               FROM revisions r
               WHERE r.project_id = e.project_id AND r.environment_id = e.environment_id
                 AND r.id = e.draft_revision_id
               LIMIT 1
           ) r
           WHERE e.project_id = $1 AND e.environment_id = $2 AND e.collection = $3
           ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC
           LIMIT 10000
